popUps.titulo: WORKS IN ALL AREAS AND SCALES
texto: Automatic sorting works for all types of areas: cities, rural areas, residential neighbourhoods… Different areas can also collect different numbers of fractions. Many municipalities even share a sorting facility, making it both cost-effective and flexible.
Households sort their waste into different streams at home, using bags of different colours. One colour for each stream (waste type).

All bags are disposed of in the same container. The container is emptied by your regular refuse truck instead of separate trucks for each stream or type of bin. This reduces emissions and traffic, and as a resident, you avoid having lots of bins on your property to accommodate different stream.

popUps.titulo: COMPATIBLE WITH EXISTING COLLECTION AND ENERGY RECOVERY
texto: Works with both manual and automated collection, and residual waste can be used for district heating and electricity or handled per local rules.
The bags are transported to a central sorting facility.
From the reception hoppers, the bags are conveyed via conveyor belts to the sorting stations, where they are sorted by colour.
The sorting facility contains various types of technology and sensors that automatically sort the bags by colour and ensure they enter the correct process.
Organic waste can be used as biomethane fuel, compost or per local rules

popUps.titulo: MAXIMISING SAFETY FOR PATIENTS AND STAFF
texto: Soiled linen, general and infectious waste are transported through a network of sealed underground pipes.
No need to move waste through corridors or lifts.
Dramatically reduces exposure to pathogens, improving hygiene and minimising risks for patients and visitors, with no cross-contamination.
Infectious waste is treated on-site and converted into non-hazardous waste at the hospital’s central collection unit.
Hazardous and heavy manual lifting is eliminated.
Improved hygiene and safety lead to reduced staff turnover, fewer sick days, and fewer manual errors.
Elevator space no longer occupied by waste, freeing it for critical patient and equipment transport.
Streamlines hospital logistics.
Less noise and fewer unpleasant odours.
Does not rely on manual labour, optimises resources, offers round-the-clock availability, and cuts costs.
Medical services are not disrupted by cleaning or waste routines, especially in critical areas.
Eliminates wear and tear on floors and infrastructure caused by waste transport via corridors and lifts.
Reduces human error, lowering related costs and providing a fast return on investment.
The automated system operates 24/7.
Adapts to demand and exceptional situations requiring more frequent waste collection.
Saves space – no need for dedicated waste lifts.
Integrating Envac's cutting-edge technology boosts the hospital’s reputation and supports compliance with the highest sustainability and regulatory standards.
Eliminates the manual transport of waste and linen, creating a safer, more hygienic experience for patients and visitors.
A cleaner, more organised, and sustainable environment attracts both patients and healthcare professionals, leaving a strong, positive impression.
